input_summary: one Zetaris SQL statement joining hospital_pg (Postgres), FDA shortage and recall snapshots (Parquet) and the FDA Orange Book (CSV file)
output_summary: 45 items in 932 ms; our own package short on FDA data: morphine sulfate, midazolam, sodium bicarbonate, atropine sulfate, dextrose, methotrexate; under an ongoing recall: lidocaine
sql:
WITH ob AS (
  SELECT concat(CASE appl_type WHEN 'A' THEN 'ANDA' ELSE 'NDA' END, appl_no) AS appl, ingredient, df_route, te_code
  FROM fda.orange_book_v
), own_ob AS (
  SELECT appl, first(ingredient) AS ingredient, first(df_route) AS df_route FROM ob GROUP BY appl
), eq AS (
  SELECT ingredient, df_route, count(DISTINCT appl) AS n FROM ob WHERE te_code LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY ingredient, df_route
), rec AS (
  SELECT ndc, first(recall_number) AS recall_number, first(classification) AS classification
  FROM fda_files.recalls_snap LATERAL VIEW explode(package_ndcs) t AS ndc GROUP BY ndc
)
SELECT f.item_id, f.generic_name, f.labeler, f.package_ndc, f.is_critical,
       round(d.days_of_cover, 1) AS days_of_cover,
       s.availability AS fda_status, s.shortage_reason,
       r.recall_number, r.classification AS recall_class,
       greatest(coalesce(e.n, 0) - 1, 0) AS equivalents
FROM hospital_pg.formulary f
JOIN hospital_pg.days_of_cover d ON d.item_id = f.item_id
LEFT JOIN fda_files.shortages_snap s ON s.package_ndc = f.package_ndc
LEFT JOIN rec r ON r.ndc = f.package_ndc
LEFT JOIN own_ob o ON o.appl = f.application_number
LEFT JOIN eq e ON e.ingredient = o.ingredient AND e.df_route = o.df_route
ORDER BY d.days_of_cover

sql:
WITH ob AS (
  SELECT concat(CASE appl_type WHEN 'A' THEN 'ANDA' ELSE 'NDA' END, appl_no) AS appl, appl_type, appl_no, product_no, trade_name,
         applicant, applicant_full_name, strength, te_code, ingredient, df_route, type
  FROM fda.orange_book_v
  WHERE ingredient = 'MORPHINE SULFATE' AND df_route = 'INJECTABLE;INJECTION' AND te_code LIKE 'A%' AND type = 'RX'
    AND NOT (appl_no = '202515' AND appl_type = 'N')
), pk AS (
  SELECT n.application_number AS appl, n.product_ndc, n.labeler_name, n.brand_name, n.dosage_form, n.strength AS listed_strength,
         n.dea_schedule, n.listing_expiration_date, trim(ndc) AS package_ndc, trim(descr) AS package_description
  FROM fda_files.ndc_morphine_snapshot n
  LATERAL VIEW posexplode(split(n.package_ndcs, ' [|] ')) a AS i, ndc
  LATERAL VIEW posexplode(split(n.package_descriptions, ' [|] ')) b AS j, descr
  WHERE i = j AND (n.application_number IN (SELECT appl FROM ob) OR n.product_ndc = '0409-1896')
), rec AS (
  SELECT recall_number, classification, reason_for_recall, recalling_firm, pndc
  FROM fda_files.recalls_snap LATERAL VIEW explode(product_ndcs) t AS pndc
)
SELECT coalesce(ob.appl, pk.appl) AS appl, ob.appl_type, ob.appl_no, ob.product_no, ob.trade_name, ob.applicant, ob.applicant_full_name,
       ob.strength, ob.te_code, ob.ingredient, ob.df_route, ob.type,
       pk.product_ndc, pk.labeler_name, pk.brand_name, pk.dosage_form, pk.listed_strength, pk.dea_schedule, pk.listing_expiration_date,
       pk.package_ndc, pk.package_description,
       s.availability, s.generic_name AS shortage_generic, s.presentation, s.company_name, s.shortage_reason, s.update_date, s.related_info, s.related_info_link,
       r.recall_number, r.classification, r.reason_for_recall, r.recalling_firm
FROM ob FULL OUTER JOIN pk ON pk.appl = ob.appl
LEFT JOIN fda_files.shortages_snap s ON s.package_ndc = pk.package_ndc
LEFT JOIN rec r ON r.pndc = pk.product_ndc

         n.dea_schedule, n.listing_expiration_date, trim(ndc) AS package_ndc, trim(descr) AS package_description
